summary: Tested Results Center (مركز النتائج) end-to-end. Backend: new pytest test_results_center_iter210.py has 15 tests, all passing. It covers settings GET/PUT (coursework_max change is blocked once marks exist, values outside range give 400), course list (scope and default active semester), coursework range checks (41, 'غ', -1, 'abc' rejected; Arabic digits '١٦' accepted), exam entry rejected before lock, lock rejected when coursework is missing, lock/unlock, coursework edit blocked after lock, eligibility from real attendance data (unexcused 20% → candidate, excused 20% → exceeded_excused, unexcused 10% → OK, board 'exempted' → eligible, board 'deprived' → not eligible), first round (16+34=50 passes, need_first=34, 61 out of range, non-eligible student rejected, 'غ' counted as 0), second round (capped at 50 by default, uncapped decision counts the full 90, a student who passed first round is rejected), exceptional (rejected without a decision, decision only allowed after failing round 2, capped gives 50, uncapped gives 70, decision delete blocked once an exceptional mark exists, 404 for a missing decision), audit log, template/export xlsx, Excel import preview/commit (ok/unchanged/rejected for not enrolled, duplicate and not allowed), RBAC/scope (Salim with no rc perms gets 403; with rc perms he sees only Sharia departments and gets 403 on another faculty's course; no unlock or publish without the perm; rc_view only can read but gets 403 on PUT marks and PUT settings), and publish (rejected while a course is unlocked; preview; draft hidden from student 1001 in /me/grades and /me/results; visible after batch publish; republish makes a new draft while the old one stays visible; undo of the draft deletes the new rc import; publishing the next draft drops the superseded rc import), plus classify() limits at 10.9/15.9/25.9 and faculty max_excused_percent read/save. The iter209 draft/publish regression suite also passes: 17/17 after a test-order fix, 32/32 combined, and the /grades complex import draft link still works. Frontend (Playwright, admin): the full workflow on a TEST course works in the UI: course card, saving coursework, lock (confirm dialog), eligibility tab, first-round entry, uncapped decision modal, second-round entry, exceptional decision with the cap toggle, exceptional entry, final tab (60/80/90 with the correct stage badges), log modal, export download, import modal preview (1/0/2) and commit, decision delete (shows the block message when an exceptional mark exists; uncapped decision removed and final drops to 50), settings modal (blocked change shown), publish modal (preview list and unlocked warning), side menu item, and general settings excused-limit-15.9. Scoped dean UI shows only his faculty, with no publish/unlock/exam-save buttons. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: The check that blocks a coursework_max change only queries courses with faculty_id == fid (db.courses.find({'faculty_id': fid})). 10 of 35 courses have no faculty_id (the faculty is found through the department in _course_faculty), so their marks are missed and coursework_max can be changed after marks exist in those courses. Fix: gather course ids by department_id in the faculty's departments, or by $or faculty_id/department_id.

coursework_pass_pct, pass_mark and the caps can still be changed after sheets are locked or published. This silently changes eligibility and results of locked or published courses. Consider blocking or warning once any sheet in the faculty is locked.

'students' counts raw enrollments, including orphan enrollments whose student document no longer exists, while the sheet and lock only use existing students. On course 6a773c33... the card says 'رُصد السعي لـ 19 من 21' while it is locked: 2 orphan enrollments, so the progress bar never reaches 100%. Count only existing students.

This route does not exist (405). The review request mentions it, but settings are read through GET /api/faculties/{id}, which does return max_excused_percent=15.9, and the frontend uses that. Informational only.

issues: rc-settings-open-btn only shows when facId can be resolved (a faculty or department filter is selected, or the user has a single faculty). For admin with faculty 'الكل' the button is hidden, even while a course sheet is open and that course's faculty is known. Consider using sheet.course.faculty_id while a sheet is open.
When the active semester is the summer semester (no term 1/2), the 'الفصل' picker defaults to 'اختر...'. This is fine, but there is no hint explaining it.

action_items: PUT /rc/settings: include courses without faculty_id (resolve through the department) in the 'marks exist' guard
Optional: guard or warn on changes to pass_pct, pass_mark or caps after sheets are locked or published
Optional: GET /rc/courses students count should ignore orphan enrollments
Optional: show the settings button inside an open sheet using the course faculty
critical_code_review_comments: results_center.py put_settings: db.courses.find({'faculty_id': fid}) misses courses that only have department_id (10/35 in DB).
_save rebuilds the whole sheet (_build, which includes course_profiles over attendance) on every PUT/import. This is fine for now but costly on large courses.

publish: courses without credit hours are left out of GPA, so if no course in a dept/level has credits, sem_gpa and sem_grade are None. Make sure credits are always set (TEST course B with credit_hours worked).
compute(): stale second/exceptional marks stay stored when an earlier round is corrected to a pass. They are ignored correctly, but the export still shows them in the second-round columns.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_results_center_iter210.py tests/test_results_draft_publish_iter209.py -q. The rc test is self-contained, using a fake semester id so publish does not need locking real courses, and publishes with notify=false. Native selects inside the PickerField testID wrapper: use locator('[data-testid=X] select'). Use absolute URLs for page.request in browser_automation. Confirm dialogs are window.confirm, so accept them with an async handler (import asyncio).
rca of the issue: The only failure seen (iter209 TestUndoDraftAfterManualEdit) was a bug in the test, not the app: the previous test class renames student 1001's reg_no to 128002 until module teardown. Fixed in the test.
